judgment.observations: The reconstruction captures the timbered room, left bunk beds, central wardrobe and fireplace, but differs substantially in framing and materials. The right foreground bunk occupies much more of the image and obscures much of the fireplace; the reference shows only a narrow bed edge there. The left beds appear smaller and farther away, and the wardrobe is shorter in the frame. The fireplace's pale stone surround and dark opening are poorly reproduced. The radiator, hearth accessories and wardrobe contents are absent or indistinct. Floorboards are much lighter and more uniform, timber beams are paler, and a large flat gray area replaces the right-side room appearance. Bed feet appear to meet the floor, though contact shadows are weak. Heavy render noise obscures bedding, surfaces and small details.
judgment.uncertain_3d_hypotheses: The foreground bunk may be positioned farther into the room or the camera may have shifted, producing the increased occlusion; the images alone cannot distinguish these causes. The wardrobe and left bunks may differ in scale or distance. Apparent floor contact is broadly plausible, but noise and occlusion prevent reliable judgments about depth, support or hidden geometry.
